name: good_boy
caption: i can't get away from this guy 😭
premise: The narrator keeps trying to run away from a guy, and every time he gets twelve blocks away he is suddenly right back next to him. Everyone is tall, he can't open doors, he's fed raw porkchops, and there's a dog that is always exactly where he is.
twist: He's the guy's dog: a tamed wolf. Tamed wolves teleport to their owner from 12 blocks away. The first-person shots hide it; every camera shot shows the wolf with the red collar from the second line on. The reveal is the first time the camera leaves his head.

lines.text: I've tried / to RUN AWAY / from this guy / THIRTY-SEVEN / TIMES.
Every time / I get / TWELVE BLOCKS / away, / I'm right / BACK / next to HIM.
I tried / at NIGHT. / I tried / through the WHEAT. / I even tried / SWIMMING.
He feeds me / RAW PORKCHOPS. / He's never / COOKED one. / NOT ONCE.
When he says / SIT, / I SIT. / I don't even / know WHY.
Everybody / in this village / is SO / TALL.
SHEEP / look SO / DELICIOUS / to me.
And there's / this DOG. / Wherever / I go, / it's ALREADY / THERE.
I can't / even open / a DOOR. / He has to / LET ME IN.
When he LEAVES, / I sit / by the door / for HOURS.
SKELETONS / RUN AWAY / when they / see me.
Last night / a ZOMBIE / HIT him.
I don't know / WHAT happened. / I just / went CRAZY.
This morning / he gave me / a PORKCHOP / and scratched / my EARS.
